policies.name: Name

propose.label: Propose Policy
propose.intent: Create a new policy in the current scope
propose.explanation: A new policy changes what actions are permitted. This affects all future requests until superseded.
propose.impact1: All future matching requests will be evaluated against the new policy.
propose.impact2: The policy takes effect immediately upon backend authorization.
propose.impact3: Existing decisions are not retroactively re-evaluated.

backendNote: Backend integration comes in a later phase. No policies or approvals are shown until the backend supplies them. This page never fabricates an authorization.
